name: Venomancer: Emerald Veil ranks stream their training level so the client stops offering an unlearnable rank (#4582)
contract: Spell.dbc gives all six Emerald Veil ranks SpellLevel 16, while they are trained at 14/22/30/38/46/54 (their
BaseLevel and the class rank progression). The client picks the highest learnable rank from SpellLevel, so from
level 16 it offers rank 6 (801152) and shows "New Rank Available!" permanently. The server's own SpellLevel
feeds the level penalty of the heal, so only the client copy changes: ranks 2-6 are streamed through
SMSG_PATCH_SPELL (opcode 2346) with SpellLevel, field 39, set to the progression's training level. Expected
before: none of the five rows arrive. After: each arrives with its training level.

steps.label: Let the login patch stream settle
Emerald Veil rank 2 (800939) reaches the client with spell level 22, the level it is trained at
Emerald Veil rank 3 (800959) reaches the client with spell level 30, the level it is trained at
Emerald Veil rank 4 (801110) reaches the client with spell level 38, the level it is trained at
Emerald Veil rank 5 (801115) reaches the client with spell level 46, the level it is trained at
Emerald Veil rank 6 (801152) reaches the client with spell level 54, the level it is trained at
